chapterInfo.content:
4
Nyansa ho afotuo
1Mma, montie agya akwankyerɛ,
na monyɛ aso na moanya nhunumu.
2Na adenim pa na mekyerɛ mo,
monnnya me mmara.
3Na na ɛberɛ a meyɛ abadoma no,
ɔbabanin ne ɔba korɔ, ma me na ne m’agya no;
4 # Lew 18.5 na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me, na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:
Ma w’akoma nsɔ me nsɛm mu,
di me mmara nsɛm so, na nya nkwa.
5Nya nyansa, nya nhunumu.
Mma wo werɛ mmfi, na mmane mfiri m’anomu kasa ho.
6Nnya no, na ɛbɛhwɛ wo so,
dɔ no, na ɛbɛkora wo.
7Nyansa ne ade titire: Enti nya nyansa,
na fa w’adenya nyinaa nya nhunumu.
8Bu no, na ɛbɛma wo so;
sɛ woyɛ no atuu a, ɛbɛhyɛ wo animuonyam.
9 # Mmb 1.9 Ɛbɛyɛ wo ti animuonyam abotire,
aane, abotire fɛfɛ na ɛde bɛhyɛ woɔ.
10 # Mmb 3.2 Me ba, tie, na fa me nsɛm,
na wo nkwa mfeɛ adɔɔso.
11 # Dwom 32.8; 27.11 Makyerɛ wo nyansa kwan,
magya wo atempɔn tee so.
12Wo nanteɛ mu w’anammɔn renkye wo,
na sɛ wotu mmirika a, worensunti.
13Sɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dendeenden, nnyaa mu,
kora no, na ɛne wo nkwa.
14 # Mmb 1.10; Dwom 1.1 Nkɔ abɔnefoɔ kwan mu,
na mfa nnipa bɔne kwan so.
15Kwati no, nsene mfa so,
mane firi ho, na siane ho kɔ.
16Wɔn deɛ wɔnna, gye sɛ wɔayɛ bɔne ansa,
na wɔntumi nna, gye sɛ wɔahwe obi ase ansa;
17na wɔdi abɔnefosɛm aduane,
na amimdie nsa na wɔnom.
18Na ateneneefoɔ kwan te sɛ owia hann,
ɛkɔ so hyerɛn kɔduru awia ketee.
19 # Mmb 13.9; 24.20 Abɔnefoɔ kwan te sɛ esum kabii,
wɔnnim deɛ wɔhunta.
20Me ba, tie me nsɛm,
wɛn w’aso ma me kasa.
21Mma no mmfiri w’ani so,
fa sie w’akomam tɔnn.
22 # Mmb 3.8, 13-16 Na ɛyɛ nkwa ma wɔn a wɔhunu,
ne nkwahosan ma ne honam nyinaa.
23Kora w’akoma sene deɛ wode sie nyinaa,
na emu na nkwa adifire fire.
24Yi ano kontonkyi firi wo ho,
na ma nkontompo ano nkɔ akyirikyiri.
25Ma w’ani nhwɛ tee,
na w’anisuatɛtɛ ntene nhwɛ w’anim.
26 # Heb 12.13 Taataa w’anammɔn pɛpɛɛpɛ,
na ma w’akwan nyinaa ntim.
27 # Deut 5.32 Mmane nifa anaa benkum,
twe wo nan firi bɔne mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Mma, montie agya akwankyerɛ,
na monyɛ aso na moanya nhunumu.
Na adenim pa na mekyerɛ mo,
monnnya me mmara.
Na na ɛberɛ a meyɛ abadoma no,
ɔbabanin ne ɔba korɔ, ma me na ne m’agya no;
na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me, na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:
Ma w’akoma nsɔ me nsɛm mu,
di me mmara nsɛm so, na nya nkwa.
Nya nyansa, nya nhunumu.
Mma wo werɛ mmfi, na mmane mfiri m’anomu kasa ho.
Nnya no, na ɛbɛhwɛ wo so,
dɔ no, na ɛbɛkora wo.
Nyansa ne ade titire: Enti nya nyansa,
na fa w’adenya nyinaa nya nhunumu.
Bu no, na ɛbɛma wo so;
sɛ woyɛ no atuu a, ɛbɛhyɛ wo animuonyam.
Ɛbɛyɛ wo ti animuonyam abotire,
aane, abotire fɛfɛ na ɛde bɛhyɛ woɔ.
Me ba, tie, na fa me nsɛm,
na wo nkwa mfeɛ adɔɔso.
Makyerɛ wo nyansa kwan,
magya wo atempɔn tee so.
Wo nanteɛ mu w’anammɔn renkye wo,
na sɛ wotu mmirika a, worensunti.
Sɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dendeenden, nnyaa mu,
kora no, na ɛne wo nkwa.
Nkɔ abɔnefoɔ kwan mu,
na mfa nnipa bɔne kwan so.
Kwati no, nsene mfa so,
mane firi ho, na siane ho kɔ.
Wɔn deɛ wɔnna, gye sɛ wɔayɛ bɔne ansa,
na wɔntumi nna, gye sɛ wɔahwe obi ase ansa;
na wɔdi abɔnefosɛm aduane,
na amimdie nsa na wɔnom.
Na ateneneefoɔ kwan te sɛ owia hann,
ɛkɔ so hyerɛn kɔduru awia ketee.
Abɔnefoɔ kwan te sɛ esum kabii,
wɔnnim deɛ wɔhunta.
Me ba, tie me nsɛm,
wɛn w’aso ma me kasa.
Mma no mmfiri w’ani so,
fa sie w’akomam tɔnn.
Na ɛyɛ nkwa ma wɔn a wɔhunu,
ne nkwahosan ma ne honam nyinaa.
Kora w’akoma sene deɛ wode sie nyinaa,
na emu na nkwa adifire fire.
Yi ano kontonkyi firi wo ho,
na ma nkontompo ano nkɔ akyirikyiri.
Ma w’ani nhwɛ tee,
na w’anisuatɛtɛ ntene nhwɛ w’anim.
Taataa w’anammɔn pɛpɛɛpɛ,
na ma w’akwan nyinaa ntim.
Mmane nifa anaa benkum,
twe wo nan firi bɔne mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
